repairs.issue: Firewall scanner treated references to PS and secret-leakage controls as protected content or credentials.
repairs.cause: Initial classifier matched control vocabulary too broadly.
repairs.change: Separated policy-reference language from actual protected/legal-origin material and high-confidence credential patterns.
repairs.regression_check: Final Batch 3 reports PS leakage PASS_NONE_DETECTED and secret leakage PASS_NONE_DETECTED.

repairs.issue: Forward-test matcher under-counted auditable controls as non-testable.
repairs.cause: Initial testability verb set was too narrow for policy/audit-style Employment rules.
repairs.change: Expanded testability to include deterministic and auditable controls that can be checked during Employment artifact review.
repairs.regression_check: Final Batch 3 reports forward-test pass rate 1 and backward-test pass rate 1.
